metadata.description: Agent skills for Jira workflow automation, Kanban reporting and quick fixes

plugins.name: jira
plugins.description: Manage Jira issues with full workflow support: search, create, update, transition, link and batch operations, with team structure, custom fields and classification.

plugins.name: kanban-master
plugins.description: Kanban board health and weekly reporting for Team Leads: who is running out of ready work, and what the team finished this week.

plugins.name: quick-fix
plugins.description: Ticket-first workflow for small changes: resolves the Jira parent, creates the ticket, then branches, implements, verifies and opens the PR.
